A pre-change binary of the separate `org.jkiss.dbeaver.erd.model` plugin containing `DiagramObjectCollector.collectTables` is binary-incompatible with the changed `DBSObjectFilter`; if that call path
The diff replaces the public one-argument method with a varargs method. Although source calls with one `String` still compile, `String...` has the JVM descriptor `String[]`, not `String`; it does not preserve the old method descriptor. E15 shows a caller in another plugin making the one-argument call, and L2 shows that the containing package is exported. A binary of that caller compiled before the change references `matches(Ljava/lang/String;)Z`, while the changed class supplies `matches([Ljava/lang/String;)Z`.
Impact: Caused by the change: The changed declaration removes the `matches(String)` JVM method and introduces `matches(String[])`. Therefore an unchanged, previously compiled cross-plugin invocation targeting the former descriptor cannot resolve against the new class and can throw `NoSuchMethodError` when executed.
